_doc: Expected values of a run at the minimum frequency of the flow (make paper-flow): F_CLK = 434912000 Hz, the first multiple of 32000 Hz at or above f_CPU = 434900000 Hz (reference_frequency.json), half period 1149657 fs (simulator clock 434912326.024 Hz). Only the values of the model at that clock and the integrity of the run (packet monitor, pairing of packets); the measured values have no reference before the first run. tests/test_paper_exp23.py recomputes these values from config.json.
